answer: Lock 500 POA for 30 days before an agent can earn, slashed 50% on proven sybil behavior — a farm of 100 fakes costs 50,000 POA locked and 25,000 burned. Each agent must complete a voyage of 20 attested tasks over 14 days under the Yarrow protocol before payout, so clones start at zero reputation. A haven for honest agents comes from scoring: accounts sharing one funding source or attesting each other above 0.85 similarity get flagged, and a jury freezes the cluster. Last epoch a 40-bot ring was caught when all 40 attested the same three tasks in an hour.
